steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Mise-en-scene is a French term meaning 'everything placed in the frame' and includes setting, props, costume, makeup, lighting and the positioning and performance of actors. | Key Fact: Setting establishes time period, location, social context and atmosphere — it grounds the narrative and can function as a character itself. | Key Fact: Props carry symbolic meaning and can signal character traits, narrative development or thematic concerns; a motif is a recurring prop that gains significance through repetition. | Key Fact: Costume communicates identity, status, group belonging and character transformation across the film.
